title: Restrict dark-theme opacity to hero avatar only
context: A regression concern was raised that dark-theme opacity may be affecting the entire page. The intended behavior is for opacity to apply only to the hero avatar image, not the whole dark theme container.

tasks.title: Make avatar-only opacity rule explicit and regression-safe
acceptance_criteria: Hero avatar opacity remains targeted only to the avatar image in dark theme
No page-wide dark-theme opacity selector is present in the hero styles
Relevant HeroSection tests pass after the change
